how.title: How it works
how.s1_d: Find your spot on the map of Armenia and decorate your room however you like.
how.s2_d: By card, on the bank's secure page. It's the only payment, with no extras. We never see or store your card details.
how.s3_d: Write what you're leaving in the old year and it burns in the fire. One place, one wish. You get your own page and a ready-made story image.

feed.title: What people are leaving behind
feed.sub: Papers appear in the fire without names. If a paper has someone's name, a phone number or a link, we don't show its text.
items: The fear of not making it

gifts.title: 20% goes to children's gifts
gifts.body: 20% of every payment goes to New Year gifts for children in Armenia who grow up without a family. From 25 to 30 December we bring the gifts to them together with trusted bloggers, and afterwards we publish what we bought and where it went.
gifts.fund_soon: The fund starts with the first payment
gifts.honest: We're a company, not a charity. We make money from this project and we don't hide it. The 20% isn't our business model; it's our decision. New Year is children's favourite holiday, and we want some of the warmth from our fire to reach them.
gifts.blogger_d: Trusted bloggers from Armenia can join us on 25–30 December, bring the gifts to the children and show everyone where the money went. Apply, and we'll get in touch.

gifts_page.title: Where the money goes
gifts_page.lead: Short and honest: how every {price} is split.
gifts_page.split_gift: New Year gifts for children without families
gifts_page.split_company: The company: bank fees, servers, the live stream, taxes and our profit
gifts_page.honest_1: This website is a business. You pay for a service and we make money from it.
gifts_page.honest_2: The 20% isn't a donation from you and isn't a charity collection. It's our own decision to spend part of our income on children's New Year.
gifts_page.honest_3: We don't say "buy to help children". If you take a place, take it because you want to. The children get their share either way.
gifts_page.dec31_d: These are the days we bring the gifts to children who grow up without a family. Afterwards we publish what we bought and which children's homes received the gifts.

lights.meta_desc: A digital map of Armenia with 111,111 places. Take yours, make your New Year room and burn one wish on 31 December.

lights.home_d: Beyond the fire, a New Year map: 111,111 plots across the country, one light on each. Light yours in your town or your ancestors' village and watch the country light up.
lights.home_yer: Yerevan has room for only 862 lights
lights.paper_line: Your place is now on the map of Armenia.
lights.story_sub: All of Armenia in one place
lights.s1: Choose any free place on the map, wherever your heart says.
lights.s2: Decorate your room and add your name if you like.
lights.s3: Pay once. Your place appears on the map and you can write one wish for the 31 December fire. 20% goes to gifts for children.
lights.only_one: One light per plot. First come, first served.

lights.lead2: We've made a digital map of Armenia with 111,111 places. Take any free place, wherever you like, make it your New Year room and visit everyone else's.
lights.final_t: Let all of Armenia light up
lights.scarce: Only 111,111 places. Our goal is to fill them all by 25 December. If we do, the map will grow and we'll announce a new plan.
